{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model catches up",
    "When price is in a downtrend, model under-forecasts lows by 0.3-0.6 points, creating persistent bearish bias",
    "Sentiment neutrality (0.00) removes model's upward bias, causing forecasts to converge toward mean-reversion levels",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias when sentiment is strongly positive, overshooting actual recovery ranges",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes widens at 30-day horizons as prices continue correcting beyond model expectations",
    "When price volatility increases, model forecasts compress toward the mean while outcomes maintain more dispersion",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to neutral correlates with 0.2-0.4 point forecast underperformance" ]}
